name: Hatanodai
tagline: Shinagawa in 18 minutes and Shibuya in 23 minutes. Served by 2 lines.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, served by Tokyu Oimachi Line and Tokyu Ikegami Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 36 minutes to Otemachi, 31 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 18 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 23.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 15.8 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 23.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 19.4 m to 35.2 m, a difference of 15.8 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 22 clinics and 16 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 昭和医科大学病院, about 339 m away and おきの会旗の台病院, about 354 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyu Oimachi Line and Tokyu Ikegami Line. All 2 lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 52.
